correctness.rationale: Every fan flip is local, disjoint in quadrilateral interior, and commutes with the others. Each diagonal indicator restricted to the resulting r-dimensional cube depends on at most one flip bit; the parity alternating sum of every degree<r Boolean monomial is exactly zero. Positive even/odd measures therefore witness nonidentifiability. The finite upper bound is a complete rank statement: two executable programs independently enumerate Catalan triangulations and construct all required presence monomial columns and independently establish full row rank modulo two for n=4..10. A nonzero minor mod two has nonzero integer determinant, so the real restricted Walsh rank is full. Both certificate paths were executed and their assertions passed.

originality.rationale: The result concerns the least degree of joint diagonal-observation functions required to span every real-valued function on polygon triangulations, plus an explicit parity-cube lower bound. The inspected primary literature establishes associahedron face posets, face counts, algebraic resolutions and affine spans of different incidence vectors, but does not state or imply this higher interaction-degree tomography theorem. Actual indexed and accessible historical-claim comparisons found no equivalent assertion. Residual unindexed priority risk remains.
residual_risks: A classical, unindexed formula for the face-facet incidence ranks of associahedra might imply the finite cutoffs.
A general interpolation theorem for flag simplicial spheres might cover the finite saturation mechanism.
The read portions and indexed searches do not constitute a complete global bibliographic search.

value.rationale: The exact minimum degree to identify every probability distribution over a natural Catalan family is an informative inverse invariant, rather than ordinary enumeration. The parity flip cube explains an all-n growing information obstruction and explicitly constructs equal-marginal but distinct mixtures, while the exact finite full-rank endpoints for n up to 10 are not automatic consequences of counts or simple local flips. This can guide future associahedral interpolation and noise-stability work without demanding a general upper bound.
